widget_desc_ring: The next prayer's name and time on a card.
widget_desc_wide: The next prayer, with the following few beside it.
widget_desc_timetable: The whole day's times, with the next one marked.
no_location_help: Grant location, or open Settings to enter your latitude/longitude manually. The app works fully offline once it has a location.
loc_off_help: Location is switched off for the whole phone, so no app can find where you are. This is separate from the permission you already gave. Turn it on below, or enter your latitude/longitude manually in Settings.
loc_no_fix_help: Your phone hasn't found its position yet. This is common indoors, on a new phone, or with “Google Location Accuracy” switched off. Move near a window or step outside, or enter your latitude/longitude manually in Settings.
loc_searching_help: The first fix can take up to a minute on a new phone, and works best near a window or outdoors.
times_approximated: The sun doesn't reach your Fajr/Isha angle today, so those two are estimated using the high-latitude rule from Settings.
location_data_credit: City names from GeoNames, used under CC BY 4.0.
qibla_no_location: No location yet. Grant location or set it manually in Settings.
qibla_loc_off: Location is turned off for the whole phone, so the Qibla direction can't be worked out. Turn it on in system settings, or set your location manually in Settings.
loc_no_fix_short: Your phone hasn't found its position yet. Try near a window or outdoors, or set your location manually in Settings.
qibla_help: Hold the phone flat and turn until the arrow points up.
ziyarat_no_compass: This phone has no compass sensor, so the dial can't turn as you move. It is locked with North at the top: face North and the needle shows the shrine, %1$ld° clockwise from there.
qibla_no_compass: This phone has no compass sensor, so the dial can't turn as you move. It is locked with North at the top: face North and the arrow shows the Qibla, %1$ld° clockwise from there.
qibla_calibrate: Compass reading is unreliable. Move the phone in a figure-8 to calibrate, and keep clear of magnets and metal.
language_help: Changes the app's language, not the phone's. Prayer names stay in Arabic.
language_card_body: You can change this anytime in Settings.
date_help: Show the Gregorian date above the timetable.
shown_rows_help: Choose which rows appear on the Salaat screen.
seconds_help: Count down to the second on the Salaat screen and on any home-screen widget. Off by default; the last minute always shows seconds either way.
notif_help: A reminder at each prayer time. Nothing leaves your phone.
notif_exact_warning: Exact alarms are off for this app, so reminders may be a few minutes late.
notif_blocked_warning: Notifications are blocked for this app, so reminders are scheduled but can never appear.
sounds_help: Plays the adhan, or a file from your phone, at prayer time on top of the reminder. It uses your alarm volume and stays quiet when your phone is silent.
sound_unreadable: That file could not be read. Try a different one.
sound_tap_help: Tap a speaker to silence that prayer. Its reminder still arrives.
sound_on_desc: %1$@ plays a sound. Tap to silence it.
sound_off_desc: %1$@ is silent. Tap to play a sound.
city_search_help: Type a city name to set your location. Works offline.
city_search_none: No city found. Check the spelling, or type the coordinates below.
location_gps_help: Using GPS / last known location. Turn this on to type a latitude and longitude (works with GPS off).
error_location: Enter a valid latitude and longitude.
custom_angles_help: Enter the sun's depression angle below the horizon for each time (degrees). Typical Shia ranges: Fajr 16–18°, Isha 14°, Maghrib 4–4.5°.
error_angles: Enter angles between 1 and 30 degrees. (Maghrib also accepts 0, meaning “Maghrib is at sunset”.)
offsets_help: Fine-tune any time to match your local timetable (e.g. +2 or −1 minute).
reset_help: Restore every option to its default.
reset_dialog_text: This returns every setting to its default. It can't be undone.
calendar_no_location: No location yet. Grant location or set it manually in Settings. Hijri dates are worked out for where you are.
calendar_loc_off: Location is turned off for the whole phone, so Hijri dates can't be worked out for your position. Turn it on in system settings, or set your location manually in Settings.
calendar_no_events: No marked occasions on this day.
calendar_method_note: An estimate: the month turns on the first crescent sighting, not the new moon, so the real start can fall a day either side. Adjust in Settings › Hijri calendar.
calendar_events_note: Occasion dates follow the common Ja‘fari narrations, and a few fall on more than one day.
calendar_times_approximated: The sun doesn't reach your Fajr/Isha angle on this date, so those two are estimated using the high-latitude rule from Settings.
calendar_offset_help: Shift every Hijri date by up to 3 days to match your marja‘ or a local sighting. 0 keeps the computed estimate.
calendar_preview_no_location: Set a location first, in Settings › Location. Hijri dates are worked out for where you are.
ev_askari_martyrdom: Martyrdom of Imam al-Hasan al-‘Askari (a), and the start of the Imamate of Imam al-Mahdi (a)
ev_mawlid: Birth of the Prophet Muhammad (s) and Imam al-Sadiq (a)
ev_fatima_martyrdom_first: Martyrdom of Sayyida Fatima al-Zahra (a), first narration
ev_fatima_martyrdom_second: Martyrdom of Sayyida Fatima al-Zahra (a), second narration
ev_ali_birth: Birth of Imam Ali (a) in the Ka‘ba
ev_ali_striking: Imam Ali (a) struck in the mihrab
welcome_body:
Thank you for downloading Shia Namaz & Qibla.

No accounts, no tracking, and no internet permission. I'll ask for your location next, used only on this phone to work out your prayer times and the Qibla. You can type it by hand in Settings instead.

May your prayers be accepted 🤲
review_body:
It's just me building this app, and reviews are the main way other people find it.

If Shia Namaz & Qibla has been useful to you, would you leave one on Google Play? Either way, thank you for using it 🤍
notif_channel_desc: A reminder at each prayer time.
sound_channel_desc: Shown while a prayer sound is playing, so you can stop it.
widgets_grandfathered: You had the app before widgets became a subscription, so they stay free for you, for good. Thank you for being here early.
widgets_how_to_add: To add one, touch and hold an empty spot on your home screen, then choose Widgets.
widgets_support_optional: If you would like to support the app anyway, you can subscribe. Nothing changes either way.
widgets_pitch: Put the next prayer and today's times on your home screen.
widgets_free_note: Prayer times, the Qibla, reminders and the calendar are free, and always will be.
bug_report_prompt: What happened, and what did you expect?
no_location_help_ios: Allow location access, or turn on “Enter location manually” in Settings and search for your city. The app works fully offline once it has a location.
loc_off_help_ios: Location Services are off for the whole iPhone, so no app can find where you are. Turn them on in Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services, or enter your location manually in this app’s Settings.
loc_no_fix_help_ios: Your iPhone hasn’t found its position yet. This is common indoors. Move near a window or step outside, or enter your location manually in Settings.
location_gps_help_ios: Using your iPhone’s location. Turn this on to search for a city or type coordinates instead (works with Location Services off).
qibla_magnetic_only: Without location access, iOS can only report magnetic north, which can differ from true north by several degrees where you are. Allow location access for an exact reading.
qibla_no_compass_ios: This device has no compass, so the dial can’t turn as you move. Face North and the Qibla is %1$ld° clockwise from there.
reminders_window_help: iOS lets an app queue a limited number of notifications, so reminders are scheduled about ten days ahead and topped up each time you open Namaz.
reminders_runout_body: Open Namaz to schedule the next days’ reminders.
adhan_pro_pitch: With Namaz Pro, a sound of your choice plays with each reminder — an adhan, a takbir, anything up to 30 seconds.
sounds_help_ios: Plays with the reminder at prayer time. iOS allows a notification sound up to 30 seconds, so longer files are shortened. It follows your ringer: silent mode keeps it quiet.
sound_tap_help_ios: Turn a prayer off to silence it. Its reminder still arrives.
sound_truncated: This file is longer than 30 seconds, so the first 30 seconds will play.
pro_pitch: Namaz is one person’s work. Pro keeps it going, and adds a few extras.
pro_feature_widgets: Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
pro_feature_adhan: A sound of your choice at prayer times
pro_free_note: Prayer times, Qibla and reminders stay free.
pro_renewal_terms: The yearly plan renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Lifetime is a one-time purchase.
pro_prices_unavailable: Prices can’t be loaded right now. Check your connection and try again.
widget_locked: Widgets are part of Namaz Pro. Tap to learn more.
widget_desc_next_ios: The next prayer, on the sun’s path through the day.
widget_desc_today_ios: All of today’s prayer times, and where the sun is along its path.
welcome_body_ios:
Thank you for downloading Namaz.

No accounts, no tracking, and nothing leaves your iPhone. I’ll ask for your location next, used only on this device to work out your prayer times and the Qibla. You can enter it by hand in Settings instead.

May your prayers be accepted 🤲
maghrib_approximated: Tonight the sun does not reach the angle used to calculate Maghrib. The app therefore uses the darkest point of the night as an estimate for Maghrib.
calendar_maghrib_approximated: On this date the sun does not reach the angle used to calculate Maghrib. The app therefore uses the darkest point of the night as an estimate for Maghrib.
pro_pending: Your purchase is pending. Pro will unlock once the purchase is complete.
pro_restore_none: No Namaz Pro purchase was found for this Apple Account.
polar_no_timetable: The sun does not rise or set normally here on this date, so the app cannot calculate a full prayer timetable. This can happen near the poles in summer or winter.
support_card_invite: Thank you for using Namaz. If you've found it useful, you can support development below 🤍
tip_unlocks_nothing: Completely optional. A tip unlocks nothing: every feature works the same without one, and Namaz Pro is separate.
tip_pending: Your tip is pending. It will be completed once the purchase goes through.
